hypothesis: Solid columns return unaided
method: A/B weigh actual parts and differential force over stroke
pass_threshold: max drag plus uncertainty <0.5mg and settle <=0.4s
fail_threshold: any persistent stick or drag >=mg
consequence: Redesign guides before motor purchase; intermediate margin is inconclusive

hypothesis: Hollow bodies retain gravity margin
method: Paired solid/hollow sets same process
pass_threshold: U01 gate for hollow with lower measured lift load
fail_threshold: Any U01 failure for hollow
consequence: Keep solid or change return mechanism

hypothesis: Clearances survive process variation
method: A three batches across bed positions
pass_threshold: No individual sanding and 30 interchangeable cell sets meet U01
fail_threshold: Individual matching needed or zero effective clearance
consequence: Change guide geometry or process without pitch increase

hypothesis: Thin guide webs survive handling
method: A 0.4 and 0.2 nozzle wall tiles
pass_threshold: All 30 samples continuous and B load/friction gates
fail_threshold: Missing web or deformation causes jam
consequence: Try 4.48mm body for 0.4mm web and recalculate mass/fill

hypothesis: Misalignment remains tolerable
current_assumed_value: No qualified tilt or size errors
method: A/B tilt 0 1 3deg fixture and guide shims 0 0.05 0.10mm
pass_threshold: U01 through 3deg bench tilt and 0.05mm guide offset
fail_threshold: Jam at declared installation envelope
consequence: Specify leveling or redesign guides

hypothesis: Dust wear orientation do not erase return margin
why_it_matters: Service degradation across thousands of cells
method: A/B clean then documented PLA dust and 10000 cycles
pass_threshold: U01 and no cracks before/after wear
fail_threshold: Any persistent stick; report intermediate margin
consequence: Add covers cleaning access or different measured material
alternative_if_failed: Low contact guides or positive return

hypothesis: Five cam levels have enough angular margin
why_it_matters: Toe must not touch higher neighboring sector
evidence: Analytical toe envelope plus scoped CSG
method: B/C angle and height measurement all levels
pass_threshold: abs angle <=6deg with uncertainty and abs height <=0.25mm
fail_threshold: Toe straddles step or changes level
consequence: Four levels improve margin; six requires new motor/detent test

hypothesis: Detent corrects one lost step
method: C release from +/-6 9 18 24 30deg
pass_threshold: Correct seat within 6deg from +/-18deg every time
fail_threshold: Wrong seat or stationary offset from +/-18deg
consequence: Legacy notch insufficient; broad profile candidate still unverified
alternative_if_failed: Broader detent or optical rotor feedback

hypothesis: Detent restoring torque exceeds drag without overloading motor
current_assumed_value: 10x1x0.45mm PLA leaf; 0.05mm preload and 0.20mm profile depth
method: C torque-angle hysteresis and capture test
pass_threshold: Seat gate plus running torque >=2x measured mechanism torque
fail_threshold: Failure to seat or drive at loaded rate
consequence: Thicker/shorter spring reruns torque strain and space
alternative_if_failed: Replaceable spring stock only if priced

hypothesis: Detent survives vibration and creep
evidence: No material allowables or vibration data
method: C 10000 cycles and 24h preload at 20 and 35C; imposed 0.2g sweep 5-50Hz
pass_threshold: No lost level and >=80% initial restoring torque and U08
fail_threshold: Lost level crack or >20% torque loss
consequence: Requalify leaf geometry/material and add detection

hypothesis: Home stop defines rotor phase after friction slip
why_it_matters: Motor step count does not measure cam angle
method: C random phase and stop contact slip with direct angle observation
pass_threshold: After rehome all levels seat within 6deg
fail_threshold: Residual phase causes wrong state
consequence: Change homing sequence or sensing and rerun timing
alternative_if_failed: Optical home or compliant indexed coupler

hypothesis: Rotor axial retention prevents lift-out
why_it_matters: Engagement thrust can move cam stack
method: C split bush and thrust collar under 2x engagement force
pass_threshold: Axial play <=0.10mm and no displacement under thrust
fail_threshold: Displacement >0.25mm or collar release
consequence: Integrate thrust housing then rerun friction and pitch

hypothesis: Cam toe bridge and guide support terrain
method: B 1N 24h and sacrificial 5N 10s each height
pass_threshold: No crack level change or permanent set >0.25mm
fail_threshold: Any fracture or unintended drop
consequence: Current cam screen has no 5N reserve; structural revision required

hypothesis: Neighbors remain independent under lateral loading
why_it_matters: Miniature placement can shift nearby terrain
evidence: Scoped nominal CAD; Test06/07 common-comb counterexample
method: B low/high neighbor patterns with 0.1N then 1N lateral force
pass_threshold: Neighbor shift <=0.10mm and no residual jam
fail_threshold: Any release or permanent jam
consequence: Revise upper guides; declare handling envelope

hypothesis: Loaded micro motor supports 400pps
evidence: Archived no-load response cannot qualify it
method: C torque-speed 100-800pps on bought motor
pass_threshold: >=0.15mNm at selected rate and >=2x measured total mechanism torque
fail_threshold: No loaded operating rate satisfies measured timing bound
consequence: Reprice better motor or stop scale

hypothesis: Fast face coupling engages repeatably
evidence: No measured friction compliance or wear
method: C axial-force sweep and random phase; D simultaneous 8 channels
pass_threshold: No slip during write; controlled home slip; durations meet <=27s replay
fail_threshold: Unbounded engagement recovery or unreliable home slip
consequence: Redesign pad/compliance and torque window

hypothesis: Electrical design remains cool and synchronized
method: C/D loaded rail current temp duty with selected winding
pass_threshold: No brownout; motor <=rated temperature and PLA mount <=40C
fail_threshold: Thermal/driver fault or drift during 30min worst duty
consequence: Reprice drivers supply cooling; rate reduction rerun

hypothesis: 80-channel fan-in and compliance fit
current_assumed_value: At least 2 staggered ranks; 320 phase wires
evidence: Test07 two-rank servo packaging fails at target pitch
method: D 8-channel shaft routing under measured engagement force
pass_threshold: All channels align without neighbor contact and timing bound holds
fail_threshold: Any channel cannot engage at measured tolerance stack
consequence: Add ranks/shafts and include mass cost and scan dynamics

hypothesis: Complete map fits conservative measured <=27s
method: C/D record per-event maxima including waits and E lift; qualify.py
pass_threshold: Measured conservative replay <=27s with fault policy
fail_threshold: >=30s or unbounded undetected faults; 27-30s marginal
consequence: Optimize only measured bottleneck; no omitted reset

hypothesis: Platen is sufficiently stiff at full span
why_it_matters: 1mm unload gap cannot tolerate large sag
method: E spliced box beam then full-width dummy grid
pass_threshold: Deflection plus racking <=0.25mm and min unloaded gap >=0.5mm
fail_threshold: Gap <0.5mm or permanent sag
consequence: Add supports ribs or purchased structure and reprice

hypothesis: Lift meets force speed and racking requirements
method: E unequal corner loads; measure torque at operating rpm
pass_threshold: >=2x measured torque margin and <=0.25mm skew
fail_threshold: Missed step jam or lost belt synchronization
consequence: Change screw lead count gearing and timing budget

hypothesis: Power loss cannot drop raised platen
why_it_matters: Terrain retention does not protect reset
evidence: None; brake missing in original geometry
method: E catch blocks and staged power cuts
pass_threshold: Descent <=0.5mm with rated load then automatic fault state
fail_threshold: Uncontrolled descent or restart without full reference
consequence: Normally engaged brake mandatory and costed

hypothesis: Printed modules fit X1C and assemble accurately
current_assumed_value: 64 10x10 guide tiles and segmented structural members
method: A/E STL bounds and joint compliance repeated assembly
pass_threshold: Every part <=256mm envelope and assembled alignment meets U03/U20
fail_threshold: Print envelope violation or joint sag
consequence: Smaller modules and calibrated datums

hypothesis: Per-cell error rates scale to useful maps
method: D >=10000 operations per channel and fault taxonomy
pass_threshold: Zero failures allows next prototype only
fail_threshold: Any unaccounted failure stops scale pending cause
consequence: Million-trial production evidence still needed

hypothesis: Correlated faults and silent errors are detectable
why_it_matters: One row fault defeats all good cells
evidence: No evidence; chip fault cannot detect slips
method: D inject stuck column slipped rotor rail dropout and module skew
pass_threshold: All 100 injected faults per class detected; ready stays false
fail_threshold: Any silent injected fault or unbounded readiness
consequence: Price and time optical inspection/recovery before scale
alternative_if_failed: Visible rotor fiducials or surface scan

hypothesis: Delivered purchased BOM stays <=500
current_assumed_value: Test09 optimistic411.60 realistic1089.65 conservative5993.85 incl contingency
evidence: Current named listings plus explicit allowances
method: Matched delivered quotes including brake feedback structure spares
pass_threshold: <=500 total incl contingency with matched qualified hardware
fail_threshold: >500 or missing necessary hardware price
consequence: Full architecture cannot qualify at present cost
alternative_if_failed: Custom selector and printed passive memory

hypothesis: Travel serves an actual miniature
method: B measure named model including base and actual stroke
pass_threshold: Usable travel >=40mm and >measured representative height
fail_threshold: Travel insufficient
consequence: Increase stroke and rerun every stack/load/timing calculation

hypothesis: Multirow independent actuators have affordable timing
why_it_matters: Single-writer rejection does not cover row groups
method: Review multirow.csv including reset park and partial last groups
pass_threshold: <=27s and quoted <=500 with loaded actuator data
fail_threshold: Timing >=30s or cost >500
consequence: Timing exists but direct drives fail screened cost

hypothesis: Multirow shared stroke local selectors are promising
current_assumed_value: 4-5 rows plausible timing with $0.4 selector target
evidence: Assumed 20ms selection and 1mm local stroke only
method: Later 2x4 full-pitch shared-stroke latch coupon dynamic selections
pass_threshold: Independent selection <=20ms loaded and cost <=calculated ceiling
fail_threshold: False selection shared release or unaffordable selector
consequence: Keep R01 open; no full head purchase

hypothesis: Maintenance and assembly do not dominate
why_it_matters: Thousands of custom fits defeat home manufacture
current_assumed_value: No measured assembly time or yield
method: A/B record labor scrap cleaning and 30 cell sets
pass_threshold: Interchangeable parts and documented repeatable cleanup
fail_threshold: Every cell needs custom fitting
consequence: Revise cartridges and re-evaluate one-person build

hypothesis: Returning clear board is acceptable use case
why_it_matters: Moving all columns can displace miniatures
current_assumed_value: No miniatures during reset; manual time not modeled
method: B representative terrain/miniature usability demonstration
pass_threshold: Mechanical readiness timer measured with declared cleared-board use
fail_threshold: Required figure handling makes full transition >=30s
consequence: Revisit reset strategy; do not hide operator time
